Binary output issue
* According to the contribution guidelines ( https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/contribution-guidelines ), binary outputs should be avoided for clashes. That's exactly the issue with your clash, as it allows only two possible answers (either 0 or 1). Please modify the output requirement to allow for more than two possible answers.

Thanks.

It's too simple, solution is literally just:
puts (gets.to_i + 1) % 2

Please if you downvote comment and explain why…
This is my first contribution, I'll be glad to learn and correct if I did something wrong…

I know, but I thought it would be tricky to understand in reverse-mode… Was I wrong ?
Thanks for your comment !
